name: video-knowledge-extractor
description: Extract knowledge from any YouTube video and automatically inject it into the most relevant skill files. USE FOR: "watch this video and add to skills", "extract and save", "learn from video", "add video knowledge to skills", "youtube to skill", "update skills from video", "extract and route knowledge", or any YouTube URL shared by the user. This skill ORCHESTRATES: fetch video → extract content → identify related skills → inject knowledge.
